title: Discrete Go / C# Native Helper Evaluation Report
reason: Primary Rust native host (src-tauri) already encapsulates process supervision, diagnostic collection, readiness health checks, and updater verification cleanly within a single binary; adding discrete Go or C# helpers increases process count, memory RSS, installer package size (+51.3 MB combined), and IPC complexity without providing isolation benefits.

evaluatedHelperCandidates.name: Go Standalone Diagnostics & Health Collector Helper

contract.singleResponsibility: Standalone collection of system diagnostics, service log aggregation, and port status telemetry
outputs: non-zero (Exit Code) + Error JSON on stderr

errorAndTimeoutBehavior.failureRecoveryStrategy: Host process kills helper subprocess on SIGKILL after 5s timeout and reads partial stderr buffer
errorAndTimeoutBehavior.versionCompatibilityCheck: Executes helper --version and validates major.minor match with host

evaluatedHelperCandidates.standaloneJustification: Decouple telemetry collection during app crash state from main process
evaluatedHelperCandidates.toolchainRequirement: Golang toolchain (go 1.22+) missing on native build runner

advantagesOverHelper: Direct access to Tauri in-memory state & log buffer without process spawn overhead

evaluatedHelperCandidates.rationale: Tauri rust host already manages logs, service health checks, and port conflict dialogs natively without needing process-level separation or extra Go binary overhead.

evaluatedHelperCandidates.name: C# / .NET Windows Runtime Verifier & Updater Bootstrapper

contract.singleResponsibility: Windows WebView2 / VC++ Redistributable prerequisite detection and background silent updater execution

errorAndTimeoutBehavior.failureRecoveryStrategy: Tauri host closes stdio pipe, logs JSON-RPC error timeout, and falls back to built-in tauri-plugin-updater

evaluatedHelperCandidates.standaloneJustification: Utilize native Windows .NET runtime APIs for WinUI/WebView2 bootstrapper

advantagesOverHelper: Tauri built-in updater plugin uses native OS HTTP and NSIS/MSI verifier without .NET runtime overhead

evaluatedHelperCandidates.rationale: Tauri host includes built-in updater and WebView2 detection (validated in L5.2/L5.3) natively, rendering a C# helper redundant and wasteful.

verdict.action: Halt Go/C# helper creation; retain single native Rust/Tauri host architecture per Master Plan Section 30 ("Avoid proliferating helper executables... One native host is preferable").
